name: Officer Corps
description: Friendly units deal increased Damage based on their current positive Morale. Level 1 adds 2% Damage per positive Morale, and level 2 adds 4% Damage per positive Morale.

name: Elemental Aspect

name: Elemental Backlash
description: After a Conflux unit counterattacks, its next committed damage gains +10% per law rank. This is battle-local bonus damage, not a separate Magic Arrow projectile.

name: Primal Wheel
description: primal spells of your heroes gain 1 level.

name: Elemental Might

name: Elemental Ward

name: Elemental Market

name: Elemental Poise

name: Elemental Exultation

name: Celestial Wheel

name: Aspect Cooldowns
description: When a Conflux hero fire or storm spell receives cooldown, reduce that cooldown by law rank. Other elemental-family cooldown mapping is not active yet.

name: Burning Ash
description: Cove gunpowder-unit hits add battle-local Burning Ash to the target. Each Ash point makes later committed damage to that target deal +5% damage, up to +30%. Rank 1 adds 1 Ash per hit; rank 2 adds 2 Ash per hit. This candidate uses custom battle state and does not mutate native buff/status data.

name: Boarding Hooks
description: When the native battle runtime reports a Cove CounterAttack ability change for this side, gain 1 Focus. This candidate uses the native Focus/Energy manager and still needs runtime proof.

name: Powder Charts
description: Whenever a Cove gunpowder unit deals committed damage, Cove gains Focus equal to this law rank. This does not directly change Heroic Strike cooldown.

name: Boarding Parties
description: Crew Mate-line units protect adjacent friendly units from ranged attacks. Adjacent friendly units take 30% less ranged damage while this law is active.

name: Gun Decks
description: The first time each battle a Cove gunpowder unit deals committed damage, Cove gains Focus equal to this law rank. This does not directly override Heroic Strike cost.

name: Prize Shares
description: After winning a battle, gain Gold equal to rank times defeated enemy squadValue divided by 18.

name: Outnumber

That next damage event deals +10% damage only if the counterattacking stack has more living units than the damaged target stack. The one-shot state is consumed whether or not the stack-count check succeeds; no native buff or status data is mutated.

name: Kill Corridors

name: Thorned Hides

That unit deals 10% less damage on its next damage event, with a minimum 1 damage reduction when possible. The weakness is custom battle-local state; no native Attack, stat, buff, or status data is mutated.
